thread:
maria: quick check — thinking about locking the edge contract as proto-first, but worried about 'fat' protobufs (lots of nested messages) causing weird quota/token accounting in the console. how do folks feel about pushing protobufs as the canonical shape + gateway-level json transpile?

ashok: I'm +1 proto-first for internal services. main worry is the gateway/console needing to show cost breakdowns per logical field. fat protos make it hard to map tokens to UI metrics.

taylor: can we separate transport from billing? i.e., keep proto on the wire but have a billing transform that flattens to a canonical token estimate before logging to console.

maria: that's the idea. but two problems: 1) we need deterministic mapping (no surprise double-counts when nested fields get expanded), 2) rollouts — we want gradual canary for clients that still call JSON.

samir: for deterministic mapping we could use a small, stable estimator step in the gateway: compute size by serialized bytes of the selected model input canonicalization. e.g. `estimate_tokens(proto_message) = ceil(bytes(proto_canonical_form)/4)` — coarse but stable.

ashok: that helps, but console UX needs per-route breakdowns not just global token counts. The gateway would need to tag spans with route+canonical-fields so the console can attribute to features.

maria: tagging at gateway is doable but we need to be careful about PII — any field-level tagging must be opt-in per route. Also affects caching: KV cache keys must use the canonicalization to avoid cache misses between proto/json clients.

taylor: example cache key snippet i sketched:

```
key = sha256(route + canonical_schema_version + canonicalized_payload)
```

if canonicalization differs between versions you get invalidation — we need a migration plan.

samir: rollout plan idea: 1) proto-first on internal-only routes, 2) gateway does proto->json for external clients, 3) enable billing-estimator v1 (bytes/4) in console as "experimental", 4) add per-route field attribution later.

maria: sounds pragmatic. one more: telemetry. we should emit both `raw_wire_size_bytes` and `billing_estimate_tokens` as tracing tags so we can correlate anomalies before we change billing curve.

ashok: +1. also add a console toggle to switch quota display between "raw bytes" and "token-estimate" so early users can compare.

taylor: agree. UX note: show a little "why different" tooltip explaining that proto canonicalization can shrink/expand compared to client JSON. keep it off by default.

samir: ops ask: how do canaries fallback on capacity-constrained Dedicated pools? if proto path fails, we should auto-fallback to json+transcode to reduce head-of-line blocking. deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: gateway-transcode-canary v1 -> staging at 2024-07-31T22:00Z.

maria: action items i hear: 1) implement stable estimator in gateway (samir), 2) add route+field tagging opt-in (ashok), 3) console toggle & tooltip copy (taylor + docs), 4) cache-key canonicalization + migration playbook (maria + infra). i'll own rollout coordination.

ashok: i'll PR a schema for field-tag opt-in and a small privacy checklist.

taylor: i'll draft the tooltip microcopy and a mock for console toggle.

samir: i'll spike the estimator and a benchmark to validate estimator vs real model tokenization.

maria: great. we'll sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
